projections.title: 2025/210 Subministrament d’equipament tècnic de telemetria i geolocalització pel projecte “reducing bycatch of threatened megafaunta in the east central atlantic” (REDUCE)
projections.description: El projecte REDUCE és un projecte europeu liderat per la Universitat de Barcelona i té com a objectiu utilitzar un enfocament científic interdisciplinari i unificar els esforços de les parts interessades per reduir les captures accidentals de la megafauna marina per part de les flotes europees que operen a la regió occidental de l’Atlàntic central. El projecte s’estructura en 9 diferents paquets de treball o Work Packages. Per al correcte desenvolupament del projecte resulta indispensable l’adquisició d’equipament tècnic especialitzat. En concret, el projecte requereix l’adquisició d’un ampli ventall de dispositius de monitoratge tant en embarcacions com en aus marines. Inclouen GPS de diverses mides i pesos, alguns amb acceleròmetres, radar o receptor AIS per captar interaccions amb vaixells, així com models amb alimentació solar o transmissió 4G o satel·litària que permeten seguiment en temps real o de llarga durada. La contractació d’aquests subministraments respon a la necessitat d’assoliment dels objectius de recerca del projecte Reducing bycatch of threatened megafauna in the East Central Atlantic (REDUCE) dirigit pel Dr. Jacob González-Solís Bou, catedràtic del Departament de Biologia Evolutiva, Ecologia i Ciències Ambientals de la Universitat de Barcelona. El projecte, amb Grant Agreement núm. 101135583 i finançat per la Comissió Europea HORIZON-CL6-2023-BIODIV-01 té com a objectiu principal utilitzar un enfocament científic interdisciplinari i unificar els esforços de les parts interessades per a reduir la captura incidental de fauna marina i informar i promoure la gestió sostenible de la pesca a l'oceà Atlàntic central oriental. projections.description: NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-27-01 LABOR CATEGORY 27– ORACLE E-BUSINESS SUITE FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONAL SME Location: Braine-l’Alleud, Belgium (on site, or as otherwise coordinated with the FinS System Management Team and confirmed by SSBA) Number of Candidates: One candidate Period of Performance: Required start date and end contract date: ASAP – 31 Dec 2026 Option period 1 Jan 2027 – 31 Dec 2027 – Option period 2: 1 Jan 2028 – 31 Dec 2028 Taskings: Perform ACT FinS Service Lifecycle Management activities as part of the ACT FinS Service Delivery Team, while co-located with the SSBA BA FinS Service Delivery Team. Be responsible for assigned Oracle E-Business Suite business applications and services. Provide first- and second-line support to ACT for assigned business applications by responding to service requests; investigating and resolving incidents and problems; communicating solutions and advice; and proposing changes and improvements based on best business practices. Gather, analyse, configure, design and document new requirements and change requests. Ensure full lifecycle testing of requests for change before presentation to users for user acceptance testing. Contribute actively to relevant projects and service operations across service lines where integration is required. Provide briefings and presentations and perform other duties as required. Conduct work one day per week on site at the NCI Agency location in Braine-l’Alleud, with the remaining effort performed remotely, in coordination with the FinS System Management Team and key users. Use the NCI Agency-provided NPCL laptop for the services. Personal or non-approved devices shall not be used to access NATO systems or data; provisioning, access activation and configuration shall be completed by the NCI Agency before work starts. Coordinate planned leave, absences and changes in availability in advance with the ACT FinS System Management Team. ACT will prioritise assigned work based on operational urgency, financial reporting deadlines, incident severity and available part-time capacity. Submit a monthly activity report by the fifth working day of the following month to the ACT Financial Controller, covering work performed, progress against assigned tasks, issues requiring ACT attention and planned activities for the next reporting period. Travel expenses shall be included in the rate. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-27-01 Essential Qualifications 1. A minimum of four years’ current, detailed and relevant knowledge and experience. 2. Basic SQL and SQL*Plus knowledge. 3. Familiarity with configuration-management and version-control procedures and tools. 4. Ability to work under pressure, on own initiative and without constant supervision, to strict deadlines; strong teamwork, communication and documentation skills; and experience supporting a highly available service. 5. English proficiency at SLP 3333 under STANAG 6001. 6. A minimum of four years’ current, detailed and relevant knowledge of and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite Releases 12.1.3 and 12.2.10+, including a basic understanding of the data model. 7. Working knowledge of the Oracle Unified Method and/or Oracle Application Implementation Methodology. 8. Detailed knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite Financials and System Administrator responsibilities, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Sub-Ledger Accounting, Purchasing, Fixed Assets, budgetary control, encumbrance and accrual accounting, public-sector accounting, reconciliations, consolidation, revaluation, period-end processes, reporting, bank reconciliation and electronic payment formats. 9. Knowledge of finance approval workflows, internal controls, access responsibilities, security rules, report groups, profile options, flexfields, workflow monitoring and troubleshooting, standard open interfaces and Approval Management Engine configuration. 10. Experience producing functional design documents, reviewing business procedures and setup, recommending improvements, and preparing, running and documenting unit, system and user acceptance tests. 11. Ability to work with System Administrator and Application Developer responsibilities and experience with WebADI. 12. Active NATO Secret security clearance. Desirable Qualifications Recent NATO experience; knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite Purchasing and Procure-to-Pay processes; experience upgrading Release 12.1.3 to 12.2.x; prior support of NATO’s custom EBS travel add-on; and experience with helpdesk ticketing systems such as BMC ITSM.
